{
  "verdict": "fix",
  "issues": [
    "GET /v1/tasks lacks query parameters for pagination, filtering, or sorting, which will cause performance degradation and usability issues as data scales.",
    "No authentication or authorization mechanism is defined, leaving all endpoints publicly accessible and vulnerable to unauthorized data access or modification.",
    "The path parameter {id} lacks a type or format constraint (e.g., UUID), risking routing failures or injection vulnerabilities.",
    "Endpoint definitions do not explicitly map 400 and 404 status codes to the provided error schema, creating ambiguity in client error handling.",
    "PATCH and DELETE operations lack concurrency control (e.g., ETags, If-Match headers, or optimistic locking), risking race conditions and lost updates.",
    "String fields (title, description) lack length or pattern constraints, allowing empty or excessively long payloads to pass validation."
  ],
  "suggestions": [
    "Add query parameters to GET /v1/tasks for pagination (e.g., limit/offset or cursor) and filtering (e.g., status).",
    "Specify an authentication strategy (e.g., Bearer tokens, API keys) and define required permissions per endpoint.",
    "Document the expected ID format and enforce it via path parameter validation (e.g., format: uuid).",
    "Explicitly associate the error schema with 4xx status codes in each endpoint's response definition.",
    "Implement ETag/If-Match headers or require an updated_at version check for PATCH/DELETE to ensure safe concurrent updates.",
    "Add minLength, maxLength, and pattern constraints to title and description fields to enforce data quality at the API boundary."
  ]
}
